name: @patch/desktop
description: Patch desktop shell — Electron wrapper around the web SPA (skeleton).

scripts.build: tsc -b && tsc -p src/first-run/tsconfig.json && node scripts/bundle-first-run.mjs && node scripts/copy-setup-page.cjs && node scripts/write-build-info.cjs
scripts.// test: Discovery is by PATTERN, not a file list (spec/19-testing.md § Unit). The hand-written list this replaced had drifted: link-policy.test.ts and tray-toggle.test.ts were on disk and absent from it, so 16 passing tests ran in no suite and gated nothing.
scripts.// dist: NO postdist. Replacing /Applications/Patch.app quits the running shell and never relaunches it, so every deploy left the desktop dead until it was started by hand. A published build now reaches this Mac the way it reaches any other — over the update feed, which relaunches on install (main.ts, patch:updater:check-and-install). `install:app` remains for a deliberate local install.
